purpose: Freeze the authoritative Skin Stage 1 outputs that Skin Stage 2 may consume when materializing independent Skin-domain Hero<->Skin relation indexes. Stage 2 must reuse the accepted 540-record canonical population, owner relation and source order without reopening Hero Stage 5-5 or raw ConfigData semantics.

canonicalHeroIdentity.role: Canonical Hero keyspace for the reverse Hero -> Skin index.

skinCanonical.role: Authoritative Skin-domain population and direct source of skinId, heroId and sourceOrder.

stage1UpstreamParity.role: Frozen proof that Stage 1 canonical membership, owner and source order preserve accepted Hero Stage 5-5 semantics.

relationSemantics.orderingRule: Hero -> Skin lists must preserve ascending sourceOrder as inherited from accepted Hero Stage 5-5 Skins_ID[] array position. No alternate chronology or presentation order is introduced in Stage 2.

stage2Does: Materialize Skin -> Hero forward relation from accepted Stage 1 canonical records.
Materialize Hero -> ordered Skin reverse index for all 267 canonical Heroes, including empty arrays for Heroes with no regular skins.
Prove forward/reverse parity across all 540 accepted skin edges.
Publish an official relation consumer contract so downstream pages do not recalculate ownership from ConfigData.
stage2DoesNot: Read raw ConfigData to rediscover Hero ownership or source order.
Infer ownership from skin names, filenames, resource paths or numeric ID patterns.
Extract, convert or map image/Spine assets to web paths.
Determine CN/KR release state or KR_FUTURE eligibility.
Regenerate the final Hero-page skin consumer beyond relation parity.

prohibitions: Do not use ConfigDataHeroInfo.Skins_ID[] or ConfigDataHeroSkinInfo.SpecifiedHero as a new Stage 2 ownership calculation source; Stage 1 parity has already frozen those semantics.
Do not re-sort Hero skin lists by skinId, Score, store UISort, acquisition category, filename or asset path.
Do not omit Heroes with zero regular skins from the reverse index; all 267 canonical heroIds must be represented.
Do not admit SP illustrations, Soldier skins or unproven skin-like assets into the Stage 2 relation population.
Do not add releaseStatus, displayTarget, KR_FUTURE or web-export fields to Stage 2 relation outputs.
completionRule: Skin Stage 2-0 is complete when this contract is committed and the referenced Stage 1 artifacts are confirmed present with Stage 1 final PASS, 540 distinct canonical skins, 267 canonical Heroes, owner/source-order mismatch 0 and hard blocker 0.
nextAction: Skin 2-1: generate the 540-record Skin -> Hero forward relation from skin-stage1-canonical.v1.json without reading raw ConfigData.
